basic_info.description: Mid century single family home was just updated for the sale. The home offers an excellent floor plan. Upstairs you will step into the open living room and dining area. The kitchen has been updated with new cabinets, countertops, refrigerator, vent exhaust, tile flooring, and light fixtures. The bathroom is located in a convenient location for all occupants and visitors. The bedrooms offer a good amount of closet space, and the locations are on opposite ends of the house for maximum privacy. The house was painted inside and outside. The hardwood floors were all polished throughout the house. Downstairs you will find an open garage that can be used as storage, work space, games space or remodeled into more house. Finally, the backyard is mostly flat and can be used for hosting events or gardening. This home is move in ready for the next owner, and it has tons of upside potential.
